author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಶಕ್ತಿಯಿರೆ ಗೌರವವು ಮಾತುಸರಿಯಿರೆ ಜನರು
ಯುಕ್ತಿಕೂಡಿರೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಫಲವನೀಯುವುದು
ಭಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದಿರೆ ಧರ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮರ್ಮವದೆ
ಶಕ್ತನಾಗುತ ಬದುಕು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: With strength comes respect; with right speech, people;
joined with wisdom, work bears fruit;
with devotion, dharma: that is the secret of life;
live growing strong, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Strength earns respect, good speech wins people, intelligence makes work fruitful, and devotion keeps us in dharma. Grow strong in all of these.
